name: Ralph
pitch: Everyone's figuring out AI. You have 6 months to do it alone, or you can give Ralph your email address and start today.

audience.pain: Don't know where to start with AI, watching colleagues pull ahead
audience.aspiration: Confident AI user without spending months figuring it out

tone: deadpan mockumentary — like The Office but for AI

imageStyle.basePrompt: iPhone photo of an overwhelmed office worker at their desk, fluorescent lighting, modern corporate office, too many browser tabs open, sticky notes everywhere. Realistic, natural colors, taken on iPhone 15 Pro. No text, no watermarks, no logos. Same grey cubicle partition visible on the right side, same wooden desk, same black monitor.
variants: iPhone photo of a confused professional staring at a whiteboard covered in AI diagrams and arrows, fluorescent lighting, modern office, dry corporate humor style, realistic
iPhone photo of someone surrounded by 4 open laptops all showing different AI tutorials, overwhelmed expression, corporate breakroom, fluorescent lighting, realistic iPhone photography
iPhone photo of a professional in a meeting room alone, presentation slide behind them says 'AI ROADMAP Q2', they're typing on phone, realistic, modern office

hooks.text: You have 6 months before everyone in your office knows AI except you
slides: Before every meeting is about AI.
Before your coworkers leave you behind.
Before leadership asks why you're behind.

hooks.text: Everyone said AI was complicated. Ralph asked me for my email address.
slides: I spent 6 months trying to learn AI.
Then someone introduced me to Ralph.

hooks.text: Your coworkers figured out AI. Here's what Ralph asked them for.
slides: Your coworkers are using AI now.
He needed one thing from them.

hooks.text: 3 months of AI courses. Or just your email address.
slides: Option A: 3 months of AI courses.
Ralph is an AI agent on Plunder & Riffle.

hooks.text: Ralph doesn't explain AI. He just needs your email.
slides: He doesn't explain how AI works.
He doesn't give you a roadmap.
He doesn't send you a course.
